summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a board resolution to issue two tranches of unsecured zero-coupon convertible bonds totaling up to NT$12 billion, with a five-year term and pricing at no less than 101% of par. The proceeds will be used to purchase machinery and equipment. The issuance is not a shelf registration; underwriting is via book building through Horizon Securities. Detailed conversion, put/call, and dilution terms are pending regulatory approval. This is a routine capital markets financing transaction, not a special situation event.
